summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, disclosing entry into an Investment Participation Agreement with Meili Capital Management Limited. Under the terms, Lion will participate in Meili's acquisition of a 10% equity interest in PT NUSANTARA BUMI SANGKARA for a total consideration of US$12 million, implying a post-money valuation of US$120 million. Consideration may be in cash, shares, or other forms per separate agreement. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals and due diligence. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch for definitive documentation and completion timing.
